title: Docker
tagline: Build, ship, secure, and operate applications in containers
summary: A practical textbook that develops a correct mental model of images, containers, the Docker Engine, builds, networking, storage, Compose, security, registries, CI, deployment, and troubleshooting. Lessons include commands, configuration examples, explicit assumptions, failure modes, and hands-on checkpoints. The course emphasizes reproducibility, safe handling of state and secrets, and the distinction between local container workflows and production platform responsibilities.
